title: Hollow Body Hold Test
texts:  Hollow Body Hold Test Assessment Test
A test of core strength endurance

Stay in a hollow body hold for as long as possible. A maximum score is reached at 2 minutes which we consider to be gold standard. Please stop at this time.

Complete the testing with your arms above your head and legs out straight. Stop the timer once you cannot hold this position any longer. Record the time completed.

This testing session is very intense on the core and lower back muscles. Only complete this testing when fresh and injury free.
